import Mathlib

inductive BinarySearchTree : Type
| Empty : BinarySearchTree
| Node : Int → BinarySearchTree → BinarySearchTree → BinarySearchTree
deriving Inhabited

def view (t : BinarySearchTree) : Set Int :=
  match t with
  | BinarySearchTree.Empty => ∅
  | BinarySearchTree.Node v l r => view l ∪ view r ∪ {v}

def is_bst (t : BinarySearchTree) : Prop :=
  match t with
  | BinarySearchTree.Empty => True
  | BinarySearchTree.Node v l r =>
    (∀ x ∈ view l, x < v) ∧
    is_bst l ∧
    (∀ x ∈ view r, x > v) ∧
    is_bst r

def get_left (t : BinarySearchTree) : Option BinarySearchTree :=
  match t with
  | BinarySearchTree.Node _ l _ => some l
  | _ => none

def get_right (t : BinarySearchTree) : Option BinarySearchTree :=
  match t with
  | BinarySearchTree.Node _ _ r => some r
  | _ => none

def get_val (t : BinarySearchTree) : Option Int :=
  match t with
  | BinarySearchTree.Node v _ _ => some v
  | _ => none

def BinarySearchTree.is_node (t : BinarySearchTree) : Prop :=
  match t with
  | BinarySearchTree.Node _ _ _ => True
  | _ => False

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def zigzig_precond (t : BinarySearchTree) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  is_bst t ∧ 
  BinarySearchTree.is_node t ∧ 
  (match get_left t with 
   | some p => BinarySearchTree.is_node p ∧ 
               (match get_left p with 
                | some x => BinarySearchTree.is_node x 
                | none => False)
   | none => False)
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode
-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definition
def zigzig (t : BinarySearchTree) 
    (h_precond : zigzig_precond t) : BinarySearchTree :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  match t with
  | BinarySearchTree.Node g
      (BinarySearchTree.Node p
        (BinarySearchTree.Node x a b) c) d =>
      BinarySearchTree.Node x a
        (BinarySearchTree.Node p b
          (BinarySearchTree.Node g c d))
  | other => other
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def zigzig_postcond (t : BinarySearchTree) (result : BinarySearchTree)
    (_ : zigzig_precond t) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  is_bst result ∧
  view result = view t ∧
  -- Structural properties: X (grandchild) is now root
  get_val result = get_val (get_left (get_left t).get!).get!
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma
theorem zigzig_view_preserved
    (g p x : Int) (a b c d : BinarySearchTree) :
    view
        (BinarySearchTree.Node x a
          (BinarySearchTree.Node p b
            (BinarySearchTree.Node g c d))) =
      view
        (BinarySearchTree.Node g
          (BinarySearchTree.Node p
            (BinarySearchTree.Node x a b) c) d) := by
  ext z
  simp only [view, Set.mem_union, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
  tauto

theorem zigzig_bst_preserved
    (g p x : Int) (a b c d : BinarySearchTree)
    (h :
      is_bst
        (BinarySearchTree.Node g
          (BinarySearchTree.Node p
            (BinarySearchTree.Node x a b) c) d)) :
    is_bst
      (BinarySearchTree.Node x a
        (BinarySearchTree.Node p b
          (BinarySearchTree.Node g c d))) := by
  rcases h with ⟨hPG, hPbst, hD, hd⟩
  rcases hPbst with ⟨hXP, hXbst, hC, hc⟩
  rcases hXbst with ⟨hA, ha, hB, hb⟩

  have hxp : x < p := hXP x (by simp [view])
  have hpg : p < g := hPG p (by simp [view])

  refine ⟨hA, ha, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro z hz
    simp only [view, Set.mem_union, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hz
    rcases hz with ((hzb | hzG) | hzp)
    · exact hB z hzb
    · rcases hzG with ((hzc | hzd) | hzg)
      · exact lt_trans hxp (hC z hzc)
      · exact lt_trans (lt_trans hxp hpg) (hD z hzd)
      · subst z
        exact lt_trans hxp hpg
    · subst z
      exact hxp
  · refine ⟨?_, hb, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro z hzb
      exact hXP z (by simp [view, hzb])
    · intro z hz
      simp only [view, Set.mem_union, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hz
      rcases hz with ((hzc | hzd) | hzg)
      · exact hC z hzc
      · exact lt_trans hpg (hD z hzd)
      · subst z
        exact hpg
    · refine ⟨?_, hc, hD, hd⟩
      intro z hzc
      exact hPG z (by simp [view, hzc])
-- !benchmark @end lemma

-- Proof content
theorem zigzig_postcond_satisfied (t : BinarySearchTree)
    (h_precond : zigzig_precond t) :
    zigzig_postcond t (zigzig t h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  cases t with
  | Empty =>
      simp [zigzig_precond, BinarySearchTree.is_node, get_left] at h_precond
  | Node g l d =>
      cases l with
      | Empty =>
          simp [zigzig_precond, BinarySearchTree.is_node, get_left] at h_precond
      | Node p ll c =>
          cases ll with
          | Empty =>
              simp [zigzig_precond, BinarySearchTree.is_node, get_left] at h_precond
          | Node x a b =>
              have hbst :
                  is_bst
                    (BinarySearchTree.Node g
                      (BinarySearchTree.Node p
                        (BinarySearchTree.Node x a b) c) d) :=
                h_precond.1
              have hbst' :
                  is_bst
                    (BinarySearchTree.Node x a
                      (BinarySearchTree.Node p b
                        (BinarySearchTree.Node g c d))) :=
                zigzig_bst_preserved g p x a b c d hbst
              have hview :
                  view
                      (BinarySearchTree.Node x a
                        (BinarySearchTree.Node p b
                          (BinarySearchTree.Node g c d))) =
                    view
                      (BinarySearchTree.Node g
                        (BinarySearchTree.Node p
                          (BinarySearchTree.Node x a b) c) d) :=
                zigzig_view_preserved g p x a b c d
              change
                is_bst
                    (BinarySearchTree.Node x a
                      (BinarySearchTree.Node p b
                        (BinarySearchTree.Node g c d))) ∧
                  view
                      (BinarySearchTree.Node x a
                        (BinarySearchTree.Node p b
                          (BinarySearchTree.Node g c d))) =
                    view
                      (BinarySearchTree.Node g
                        (BinarySearchTree.Node p
                          (BinarySearchTree.Node x a b) c) d) ∧
                  some x = some x
              exact ⟨hbst', hview, rfl⟩
  -- !benchmark @end proof
